what_you_want.tradeoff: I'd take about 10% less pay for a company that won't lay people off every year.
what_you_want.pay_floor: $115K base, flexible if equity is real
what_you_want.pay_notes: My parents are on my health plan, so benefits matter as much as base.

what_you_want.locations: Chicago, or remote within US time zones; 45 minutes max commute
what_you_want.company_size_why: I was laid off from a 30-person startup last year and my visa clock started the same day.
what_you_want.timeline: About four months before savings get tight.
must_haves: Works with real data, not just dashboards
A manager who has done analytics work
dealbreakers: Five days a week in the office

about_you.strengths: I turn messy operational data into decisions people actually use. I'm the one who finds out why the numbers don't match.
about_you.voice_sample:
Hi Sam,

I saw the analytics role on your team and wanted to reach out directly. I've spent four years cleaning up shipping data so ops leads could trust it.

Priya

stories.title: Reconciling the shipping numbers
stories.notes: Finance and ops had different on-time rates. I traced it to two definitions of "delivered" and got both teams to agree on one. Don't remember the exact % change, it was a lot.
Built the first weekly metrics email; people still ask for it by name. Literal {{ braces }} and it's got an apostrophe.
We launched a forecast that was wrong for two weeks.

work_authorization.notes: My spouse's H-4 depends on my status.

risk.layoff_impact: I'd have 60 days to find something or leave, with my spouse.
